headline: Bing Merchant Center free listings may require active ads to display, impacting AI search indexing

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Bing Merchant Center free listings may require active ads | Bing Merchant Center 免费商品列表或需启用广告后方可展示
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: 尽管官方文档声称免费列表无需广告，但测试表明未启用广告时可能无法展示，直接影响 Bing AI 和 ChatGPT 的商品数据召回。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence: Practitioner observation of Bing Merchant Center product indexing behavior.
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: SEO consultant Brodie Clark observed in an experiment that free product listings in the Bing Shopping tab only began displaying after enabling active ad campaigns, directly contradicting Microsoft's official documentation. This suggests a potential 'pay-to-play' gate for indexing, which is critical for brands leveraging product feeds to feed Bing AI and ChatGPT's search indexes.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 在 Bing Merchant Center 中为商品 feed 启用低预算广告，测试是否能激活免费列表的展示与 AI 引用。
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 针对已配置 Bing Merchant Center Feed 但未投放广告的电商站点，启动一个极低预算（如每日 1-5 美元）的伴随式购物广告系列。在 7-14 天内监测 Bing Merchant Center 后台的‘免费列表（Free Listings）’状态、曝光量以及 Bing AI/ChatGPT 中的引用变化。
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: Bing Merchant Center 中免费列表的曝光量与点击量，以及 Bing AI/ChatGPT 中该商品的引用频次。
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 低成本（仅需极少广告预算），低风险（预算可控，不影响现有 SEO 架构）。
